name: Would you rather but it happens
desc:
Ever wondered what would really happen if you chose left or right?
In this game, every Would You Rather choice becomes reality.

💥 Pick an option
⚡ Watch it instantly happen
😱 Survive the consequences

From harmless fun to total chaos, your decisions shape the game. Choose wisely… or regret it.

👍 100,000 Likes for More Doors!
